The NAVs were calculated on a fair-value basis using bid prices with debt valued at par and provisions for performance fees included where applicable; only undiluted NAVs are shown in this release. This routine NAV update provides current per-share net asset metrics that market participants will use to assess valuation relative to the company's share price.
